children: Market Technology Acquisition reported net income in the quarter, driven by $1.3M of interest earned on Trust Account investments, partly offset by $220,796 of formation, general and administrative costs. The company has not begun operations and will not generate operating revenue until after a business combination.
: The company is focusing on capital-markets businesses, particularly U.S. equities and options clearing, market infrastructure and financial-technology platforms.
: Investments totaled $207.4M at September 30, 2026, including $1.3M of interest income.
: Cash was $1.0M and working capital was $1.1M at September 30, 2026.
: The company has until April 27, 2028, or an earlier date approved by its board, to complete a business combination.
